<thought>Since the bond criteria caused an error, I'll search the template catalog using only the functional group criteria (broken aromatic hydroxyls and ketones, formed ether oxygens). This should return the template that matches the described reaction. Then I can apply that template to the target molecule CCCCCCCCCCCO to obtain the possible precursor sets.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CCCCCCCCCCCO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aromatic hydroxyls", "ketones"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"]
}</action_input>
